Cooling checks, some useful tips at midday
We write to travelers

Travelers with companion animals should review their journey plans before arrival and follow the guidance given at Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk Notice

Please keep your animal calm, hydrated, and secured in an approved carrier until a member of staff gives further direction. If you are preparing for boarding, the passenger coordinator will guide you through the required steps and help you understand what to present at each stage. Quiet handling and clear documents make the process smoother for everyone.

At the skyport, staff may direct you to the pet relief area or to a waiting point that supports safe movement through the terminal. <<FACT F017>> A welcome team member can also help with basic reminders for comfort and boarding readiness, and the desk will note any special support needs you have shared in advance. <<FACT F008>> Please keep your carrier closed unless a staff member asks you to open it, and keep leash use consistent with station advice.

For calm, careful assistance before travel, please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
